name: Misty Pagoda — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Tiered teal upturned roofs around a timber/gold lattice pagoda, hanging bells, central entrance stair, low stone base and open peripheral gallery. Small plan has radiating/lobed court extensions; isometric keeps compact vertical mass. Hidden layout inference: An entry terrace leads to one compact central hall with a loop around its lowest gallery; higher tiers remain smaller lookouts rather than becoming huge palace floors. Place small planted corner courts and a quiet pond off the main stair axis. Bamboo/maple are proposed additions, not visible confirmed species. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B06-STRUCT-001 — Misty Pagoda — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Source has roof tile, lattice, bell and carved bracket motifs. Audit existing parked B06 surface sheet before generating any new surfaces. Likely needs stacked column/floor corner, roof ridge/hip and stair-plinth junction geometry; koi/dragonflies remain proposed habitat fauna. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
